items.recipe: Extend scripts/check-perf-budget.mjs to emit .cache/perf-fix-recipes.json keyed by (route × profile) when median LCP or CLS busts budget. Recipe = ranked candidate fixes by failure class: (LCP-blocking → 'audit critical-shell coverage + add fetchpriority=high to LCP image'; LCP-render → 'check idle-loader gates / drop forwards fill-mode on hero animation'; CLS-shift → 'audit reserved geometry in critical shell for route'). Wired into npm run build:check as advisory output. Foundation for autonomous fix loop S159+.

Add /security/trusted-types/ public-safe page showing aggregate Trusted Types violation report counts by url-path-prefix + directive. Renders from /api/tt-summary.json (new generated artifact). For now, generate placeholder summary at build-time (zero samples until KV ring accumulates). New scripts/build-tt-summary.mjs reads optional CSV/JSON export from KV via Worker /v/tt-summary admin route (Bearer-gated) OR emits empty-but-valid shape. Page is dark, atmospheric, brand-consistent.

Resolve S158 carry [PROTOCOL-SCRIPTS] by adding scripts/check-obelisk-posture.mjs (reads context/OBELISK_ADOPTION.md if present, reports posture) + scripts/watch-registry-changes.mjs (no-op stub with TTL-respecting design hint). Both <40 lines. Remove the allowlist exception; verify check-protocol-scripts --info reports 0 missing.

scripts/check-touch-targets.mjs parses assets/style.css and shell CSS for explicit width/height/min-* declarations on interactive selectors (a, button, .btn, [role=button], input[type=text|email|search|password], .tap-target). Fails when a selector's computed touch box drops below 44×44 inside @media (max-width:768px). Self-test 6 cases. Wired into build:check as advisory.

Audit critical-shell injection in scripts/build-shell-assets.mjs and ensure <link rel=preconnect crossorigin> exists for cdn.jsdelivr.net + supabase project URL on pages that use them. Add idempotent injection. Expected save ~80-200ms TLS+DNS on first-paint resource fetches.

scripts/export-perf-history.mjs --out docs/PERF_HISTORY.csv converts data/perf-history.ndjson into spreadsheet-friendly columns (timestamp, route, profile, lcp, cls, ttfb, fcp). Idempotent, deterministic ordering by ts asc. Enables offline analysis without re-running browser traces.
